title: SEAL — measurement seal overview | CSOAI
text: SEAL — measurement seal overview | CSOAI Home DEFONEOS-SEAL Audit Products SEAL The SEAL is the signature on every published CSOAI figure. It is an Ed25519 signature over a canonical representation of the measurement, anchored in a hash chain the public can recompute. What SEAL means Signed — Ed25519, with the public key published in /.well-known/agent.json . Hash-chained — every SEAL references the prior SEAL. Re-writing history breaks the chain. Recomputable — the harness is public; given the inputs, you can rerun the measurement. Council-ratified (for DEFONEOS-SEAL) — issued after a designed 33-agent council review. What SEAL does not mean Not a certification. We are a measurement body. Not a compliance statement. Only a regulator can say "compliant." Not a guarantee of future behaviour. The SEAL is a snapshot. Not a substitute for legal counsel. How SEAL differs from DEFONEOS-SEAL SEAL — the lightweight signature on a single measurement. Used on every published figure. DEFONEOS-SEAL — the heavier sovereign governance credential. Requires a 23/33 threshold review by the designed 33-agent council. Used for sovereign-tier certifications. Verify a SEAL Every figure on csoai.org has a companion record with the unsigned payload, the signature, and the chain reference. The verifier is at /audit.html . Related DEFONEOS-SEAL — sovereign AI governance seal (heavier). Audit — SIGIL receipt verifier. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
